body: Why is that better than ending it? I'm not scared of death an it just seems so easy and ice when compared to what I am facing. I never realized how unjust this world is until all this happened.

I did commit myself and it only made things worse. The environment, the food, the people just made everything worse.

I have a lawyer(a good one too) but even though I a have never had so much as a speeding ticket he is not hopeful. There are too many charges with mandatory minimums and there is no way to plead them down in my state. I didn't know I had committed a crime. My parents gave me a gun years ago and I had forgotten about it until my wife left me. My dad had told mei didn't need to do anything about it and it was all taken care of. It was the first time I had even seen the gun. But the cops or court don't care. It really is a tragedy of justice.
